szoveg_eredeti:
SpaceX has ordered 100 GW/year of HJT solar manufacturing equipment from Singulus in Germany. 

This is for Starmind to create a sentient sun.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: SpaceX (@SpaceX); megjelent: 2026-11-10T19:04:12+00:00; link: https://x.com/SpaceX/status/2120231065394590007; média: nincs média]
We have signed a major supply contract with SINGULUS to create a durable option for advanced solar cell manufacturing to support more than 100 GW of equipment as we accelerate the production of our Starmind satellites in Bastrop, Texas → https://www.singulus.com/2026/11/10/spacex-heterojunction-solar-cells-singulus/
